Initial clustering pre-Decontx and ScDblFinder (using BPCells)
```{r}

library(Seurat)
library(Matrix)
library(magrittr)
library(BPCells)
mat = open_matrix_dir("./combined_bpcells_mat/")
# Normalize by reads-per-cell
mat <- multiply_cols(mat, 1/Matrix::colSums(mat))
# Log normalization
mat <- log1p(mat * 10000) # Log normalization

stats <- matrix_stats(mat, row_stats="variance")

# To keep the example small, we'll do a very naive variable gene selection
variable_genes <- order(stats$row_stats["variance",], decreasing=TRUE) %>% 
  head(2000) %>% 
  sort()

mat_norm <- mat[variable_genes,]

mat_norm <- mat_norm %>% write_matrix_memory(compress=FALSE)

gene_means <- stats$row_stats["mean",variable_genes]
gene_vars <- stats$row_stats["variance", variable_genes]
mat_norm <- (mat_norm - gene_means) / gene_vars

svd <- BPCells::svds(mat_norm, k=30)
pca <- multiply_cols(svd$v, svd$d)

graph_pre_clustering <- knn_hnsw(pca, ef = 1000) %>% # Find approximate nearest neighbors
  knn_to_snn_graph() 

clusters = graph_pre_clustering %>% 
  cluster_graph_leiden(resolution = .05) 
library(tidyverse)
markers_per_clust = marker_features(mat = mat, clusters)
markers_per_clust = markers_per_clust %>% mutate(l2fc = (foreground_mean - background_mean)/log(2))
markers_per_clust = markers_per_clust %>% mutate(cpm_expression = 100*(2^foreground_mean - 1))



genes <- c("RBFOX1", "SYT1", "RBFOX1", "SYT1", "GFAP", "AQP4", "CSF1R", "CX3CR1", "TMEM119", "PTPRC", "SKAP1", "AQP4", "PDGFRA", "VCAN", "MEGF11", "SYT1", "SNAP25", "PDGFRB", "CLDN5", "FLT1", "MBP", "MOG", "MAG", "S100B", "GFAP")

cur_markers_select = cur_markers %>% filter(feature %in% genes)
#1- neuron
#2- neuron
#3- neuron
#4- oligo 
#5- oligo
#6- astro
#7- vascular
#8- immune
#9- oligo
#10- opc
#11 - neuron
#12- neuron
#13- astrocyte
#14 - vascular
#15 - oligo
#16 - immune
```

```{r}
# Map each Leiden cluster number to the cell-type name assigned above.
# Looking up by name (not position) so it's robust to factor-level ordering.
cluster_annotation <- c(
  "1"  = "neuron",
  "2"  = "neuron",
  "3"  = "neuron",
  "4"  = "oligo",
  "5"  = "oligo",
  "6"  = "astrocyte",
  "7"  = "vascular",
  "8"  = "immune",
  "9"  = "oligo",
  "10" = "opc",
  "11" = "neuron",
  "12" = "neuron",
  "13" = "astrocyte",
  "14" = "vascular",
  "15" = "oligo",
  "16" = "immune"
)

cell_clusters <- tibble(
  cell_id   = colnames(mat),
  leiden    = as.character(clusters),
  cell_type = unname(cluster_annotation[as.character(clusters)])
)

# Sanity checks: one row per cell, every cluster got a label
stopifnot(nrow(cell_clusters) == ncol(mat))
stopifnot(!anyNA(cell_clusters$cell_type))

cell_clusters <- cell_clusters %>%
  mutate(sample = str_extract(cell_id, "^[^_]+"), .after = cell_id)

cell_clusters %>% count(sample)
head(cell_clusters)
```

Run Decontx per sample, then add to new decontx bpcells obj
```{r}
original_mat = open_matrix_dir("./combined_bpcells_mat/")
unique_samples = cell_clusters$sample %>% unique

decontx_no_counts_results_list = vector(mode = "list", length = length(unique_samples))
names(decontx_no_counts_results_list) = unique_samples

for (i in 1:length(unique_samples)) {
  sample_id = unique_samples[i] %>% as.character()
  cur_sample_df = cell_clusters %>% filter(sample == sample_id)
  cur_sample_cells = cur_sample_df %>% pull(cell_id)
  cur_sample_ge = original_mat[,cur_sample_cells] %>% as("dgCMatrix")
  cur_sample_broadclasses = cur_sample_df$cell_type
  decontx_cur_sample_result = decontX::decontX(cur_sample_ge, z = cur_sample_broadclasses)
  cur_decontx_counts = decontx_cur_sample_result$decontXcounts %>% as("IterableMatrix") %>% round()
  if (i == 1) {
    all_decontx_counts = cur_decontx_counts %>% write_matrix_dir("./decontx_counts",overwrite = T)
  } else {
    all_decontx_counts = cbind(all_decontx_counts, cur_decontx_counts) 
    all_decontx_counts = all_decontx_counts %>% write_matrix_dir("./decontx_counts",overwrite = T)
  }
  
  #remove counts from decontx_cur_sample_result then save the rest of the object to the decontx_no_counts_results_list (ex: has contamination score, etc.)
  decontx_cur_sample_result$decontXcounts = NULL
  decontx_no_counts_results_list[[sample_id]] = decontx_cur_sample_result
  gc()
}
```


Run scDblFinder per library
```{r}
library(scDblFinder)
mb_counts = open_matrix_dir("./decontx_counts/")
mb_counts_df = tibble(
  cell_id   = colnames(mb_counts),
  cell_type    = cell_clusters$cell_type[match(colnames(mb_counts), cell_clusters$cell_id)],
  sample = cell_clusters$sample[match(colnames(mb_counts), cell_clusters$cell_id)]
)

mb_counts_dgc_matrix = mb_counts %>% as("dgCMatrix")

```


```{r}
library(SingleCellExperiment)

sce = SingleCellExperiment(
  assays  = list(counts = mb_counts_dgc_matrix),
  colData = DataFrame(mb_counts_df, row.names = mb_counts_df$cell_id)
)

# Per-library doublet detection. `samples` points at the colData column,
# so each sample is processed independently.
sce = scDblFinder(sce, samples = "sample",clusters = "cell_type", BPPARAM = BiocParallel::MulticoreParam(workers = 8))

# scDblFinder writes its results into colData; pull them back onto the df
mb_counts_df = mb_counts_df %>%
  mutate(
    scDblFinder_class = as.character(sce$scDblFinder.class),
    scDblFinder_score = sce$scDblFinder.score
  )


saveRDS(mb_counts_df,file = "doublet and initial cell types pre qc.rds")
```
